title: Sr Business Systems Analyst
description:
We are transforming how our Players engage with our games and brand in an increasingly digital world. You will be on a team that is driving the future of our business by enhancing WCLC's digital presence by delivering innovative solutions. Be a part of a team that is shaping the next chapter of digital excellence for WCLC and our Players.


**The Role**



The Western Canada Lottery Corporation (WCLC) is looking to add a Senior Business Systems Analyst to our Application Delivery team in Winnipeg.  

  

You’ll play a crucial role in bridging the gap between business needs and technical solutions. Your analytical mindset and exceptional communication skills will help you gather and analyze requirements, identify opportunities for improvement, and design innovative solutions that that help us support our players and internal stakeholders. With your ability to manage stakeholders and collaborate effectively with technical teams, you will be a key driver in helping our teams deliver high\-quality solutions that meet business objectives and exceed customer expectations. Join our team and bring your expertise to a dynamic and growing organization.



We’re looking for someone who can…


**Support Project implementations \- 75%**


* Work in partnership with preferred vendors to understand product roadmaps and recommend new solutions and ideas

Apply industry\-standard methodologies – including Agile and SDLC frameworks * \- to translate business requests into functional requirements, prototypes, and technical solutions
* Develop detailed functional and nonfunctional requirements, system design specifications, workflow designs, data mapping, system specifications, and other documentation as required
* Work with architects and technical leads to understand, document, and evaluate software applications and system interfaces
* Evaluate current business problems and provide advice on the applicability and usability of alternative products or solutions
* Lead meetings to explain our technical landscape and complexities to all relevant stakeholders, ensuring alignment to Architecture standards, regulatory requirements and/or security controls.
* Work with vendors and external partners to identify prioritization conflicts and propose alternative solutions or options
* Rationalize and document technology requirements that would match with proposed products/services to address stakeholder needs
* Contribute to the design of roadmaps for processes, applications, systems, new functionalities, data migration, and conversion
* Work with cross\-functional teams to enhance player experience by understanding core offerings and identifying opportunities for enhancements in vendor solutions
* Work on multiple projects and meets deliverables through goal setting, time management, planning and leveraging practices and process to manage and simplify work
* Proactively seek out and recommend process, automation, and system opportunities to reduce manual effort/time and decrease implementation time
* Conduct and document impact and gap analysis
* Contribute to the maturity of the Systems Analysis domain using continued learning approach and IIBA standards


**Help drive small enhancements \- 25%**


* Work in a collaborative, iterative environment to efficiently deliver enhancements and new features to existing systems and applications
* Evaluate requests for application enhancements or upgrades to determine impact to business and integration systems (downstream system dependencies and data feeds/API’s)
* Work with the Product Owner and other Business Analysts on the prioritization of the product backlog of user stories, and defining acceptance criteria sufficiently for testing
* Update living system documentation based on enhancements and changes
  


 **Qualifications**

  

* **Experience \& Education** Minimum 3\+ years as a Senior Business Systems Analyst/System Analyst or 5\+ years at the Intermediate level, including documenting system specifications, gap analyses, functional and non‑functional requirements, workflow diagrams, process models, and data‑mapping artifacts. Requires a degree or diploma in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Management Information Systems, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
* **Technical \& Analytical Skills** Advanced experience with SQL, XML, JSON, functional specifications, process‑mapping tools (such as Visio), Jira, and Confluence. Skilled in evaluating system integrations, APIs, data flows, and downstream application impacts. Experience supporting digital transformation initiatives, enterprise platforms, and data‑driven solutions.
* **Delivery \& Methodology Expertise** Demonstrated experience working within Agile and SDLC environments, including analysis, design, prototyping, integration, testing, deployment, and support of cloud‑based, vendor‑hosted, web, mobile, or enterprise applications. Experience collaborating with third‑party vendors, SaaS providers, and working within vendor‑managed services models.
* **Collaboration \& Stakeholder Engagement** Ability to work effectively in virtual, cross‑functional teams across geographies. Strong stakeholder management, facilitation, and communication skills with the ability to bridge business and technical teams.
* **Personal Attributes \& Work Style** Highly organized with the ability to manage multiple competing priorities under time pressure. Demonstrates personal ownership, collaborative teamwork, adaptability, innovation, and a holistic, value‑centric perspective.
  


**Who we are**



You may not be very familiar with WCLC, but you’re almost certainly familiar with the products we help bring to players throughout the Prairie Provinces and the North every day; lottery games like LOTTO 6/49, SPORT SELECT, and dozens of instant scratch tickets.



 WCLC is the non\-profit organization authorized to manage, conduct, and operate lotteries – at retail and online – and other gaming\-related activities for the governments of Alberta, Saskatchewan, and Manitoba as well as the Yukon, Northwest Territories, and Nunavut. We entertain our players while building the future of lottery – delivering innovative, responsible, and trusted experiences that provide growing value for our provinces and territories



 We know it’s our people that make this possible, which is why we invest in building talented, adaptable, and accountable teams who are proud to live and work in our region. We offer a challenging, collaborative work environment, competitive benefits, and a good work\-life balance.



 We’d love to talk to you about how you fit into that.

description:
**Who We Are:**  

Price Industries Limited, North America’s leading manufacturer and distributor of air distribution products (www.priceindustries.com). The founding principles of Price have never changed – business integrity, first\-class service, innovation and a commitment to people. Our dependable quality, reliable delivery, and knowledgeable follow\-up service have made Price a market leader in supplying air distribution, critical controls, and noise control products.
  
After more than 60 years, Price remains a privately held family company with a deep heritage and commitment to innovation and service. Our long\-standing vision, values, and the Price way of doing business are the cornerstones of our success.
  
We are a dynamic, progressive and innovative organization looking for new talent in our growing Winnipeg manufacturing facility. If you thrive on new challenges, and working in a friendly, team\-driven environment, you should consider the following opportunity.
  
  

**What You Can Expect:**  

Health and Dental \- Employees and their families enjoy paid benefits covering an extensive list of medical and dental expenses and services.
  
  

PocketPills \- You and your family will have free access to Canada’s first Digital Pharmacy, PocketPills enables you to call, text or email the pharmacy care team from wherever you are. You will enjoy free delivery of your prescriptions and vitamins straight to your home.
  
  

Employee and Family Assistance Program (EFAP) \- You and your family will have free access to consultation and support for your mental, emotional and financial well\-being
  
  

Life and Disability \- You will be provided with life insurance in a multiple of your salary with an option to purchase additional coverage.
  
  

Pension Matching Program \- Invest in your future with each pay cheque through our Defined Contribution Pension Plan and we will match your contribution (up to 3% of your salary).
  
  

Gym Subsidy Program \- Employees are eligible for a gym membership reimbursement of up to $300 per year, this includes Fitness related App’s.
  
  

As part of our Goals, Rewards, Improvement and Teamwork program qualifying teams can enjoy a monthly reward.
  
  

Personal and Professional Development \- We are committed to helping you reach your potential through training and education.
  
  

Community Involvement \- Generously supporting health, charities, youth, and education opportunities is our passion, and you’re invited to be a part of that.
  
  

ERP Implementation Lead – Site Role
  
  

**Purpose:**  

Serve as the primary point of contact for ERP deployment at the site, ensuring alignment between corporate ERP strategy and local operations.
  
  

**Key Responsibilities:**  

* Plant\-Level ERP Management: Manage day\-to\-day and performance of the ERP system within the plant, ensuring data integrity, security, and uptime for all manufacturing processes.
* Operational ERP Support: Serve as the primary contact for ERP\-related issues on the plant floor, providing expert\-level troubleshooting, training, and support across production, inventory, purchasing, and quality control.
* Corporate Compliance \& Implementation: Act as the plant\-level liaison for the corporate ERP team. Ensure local operations comply with corporate\-driven system standards, policies, and best practices.
* Business Process \& Data Optimization: Work with plant leadership to analyze workflows and optimize them within the ERP framework. Ensure accurate data entry and integrity aligned with corporate governance standards.
* Reporting \& Analytics: Work with reports, dashboards, and analytics developed by the IFS team, ensuring plant users understand how to interpret and apply the information to support operational decisions.
* Change Management \& Training: Lead local change management efforts for ERP updates and new module rollouts. Develop and deliver training programs for plant personnel.
* Continuous Improvement: Assist site level users with user acceptance training. Identify opportunities for system enhancements and process improvements. Propose and implement solutions aligned with corporate strategic goals.
* Team Leadership \& Development: Operate as an individual contributor with future responsibility to build and lead a team of local ERP support staff, ensuring scalability and operational excellence.


**The ideal candidate for this position will have:**  

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field.
* 5\+ years of experience working in the IFS ERP system
* Proven experience as a software architect or similar role, with a focus on ERP systems.
* In\-depth knowledge of manufacturing processes, including product configuration, bill of materials (BOM), routing, and shop floor control.
* Strong understanding of other ERP systems as applied in the manufacturing sector, such as IFS, Infor Syteline, Microsoft Dynamics, would be an asset.
* Experience with advanced planning and scheduling (APS), manufacturing execution systems (MES) and product lifecycle management (PLM) is desirable.
* Excellent analytical, problem\-solving, and communication skills.
* Ability to work collaboratively in a cross\-functional team environment and manage multiple priorities effectively.


**Collaboration:**  

Partners with Manufacturing, Finance, Sales, Engineering and Shared Operations Domains. As well as Manufacturing Engineers, Site Leadership, and Corporate ERP teams (Business Analysts) to ensure successful implementation meeting site needs under the corporate standard

We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity. All employment is decided on the basis of qualifications, merit and business need.

title: Project Manager
description:
The Western Canada Lotter Corporation (WCLC) is currently looking for a Project Manager to join our Enterprise Portfolio Management Office (EPMO) based in Winnipeg, Manitoba.



The EPMO is responsible for creating business value by providing all areas of WCLC with project and portfolio management services to support the delivery of business objectives. Working closely with Business Sponsors, Executive Sponsors, IT Leaders, provincial and territorial stakeholders, vendor partners, and lottery stakeholders, you will be responsible for the development and execution of project plans that support key organizational initiatives. You will work with cross\-functional teams, manage stakeholder expectations, and coordinate delivery activities to meet agreed scope, schedule, budget, quality, and governance objectives.

  

**We’re looking for someone who can…**


* Lead projects with enterprise\-wide and multi\-stakeholder impacts, collaborating closely with lottery partners, business units, technology leaders, cross\-functional teams, project team members, vendors, and external stakeholders to ensure initiatives are well\-defined, accurately planned, and successfully delivered.
* Work collaboratively to develop and maintain project governance materials, including the project charter, scope, objectives, delivery approach, success measures, stakeholder engagement plan, communication plan, and decision\-making framework.
* Facilitate project meetings, planning sessions, workshops, status reviews, and governance forums to support alignment, transparency, and timely decision\-making.
* Drive project execution and delivery by managing integrated project plans, dependencies, milestones, deliverables, risks, issues, decisions, and action items across multiple workstreams.
* Develop comprehensive project plans showcasing financial and project management skills, including cost estimates, budgeting, forecasting, resource planning, and reporting across the project lifecycle.
* Manage the tracking and control of project scope, schedule, budget, issues, decisions, assumptions, dependencies, and change requests.
* Manage project budgets and costs and provide estimates, forecasts, and financial analysis, including capitalization, amortization, and expense management where applicable.
* Perform risk planning and analysis, including risk identification, assessment, response planning, mitigation tracking, and escalation at the project, program, and enterprise levels where warranted.
* Execute, track, and monitor progress against the plan and communicate project status, risks, decisions, and key updates to project teams, sponsors, executives, governance groups, and external partners.
* Contribute to organizational change, adoption planning, transition readiness, and process improvements across teams, including the effective implementation of changes in processes, procedures, and ways of working.
* Demonstrate a blend of business, technology, and stakeholder management acumen to ensure project deliverables and anticipated outcomes align with business objectives and partner expectations.
* Provide valuable insights and recommendations on delivery methods, governance practices, reporting, stakeholder engagement, and continuous improvement opportunities when working collaboratively with project management and leadership teams.
* Engage and collaborate with governance stakeholders to ensure project delivery aligns with corporate risk expectations, cybersecurity controls, technology standards, procurement requirements, vendor obligations, and organizational governance processes.
* Look for opportunities to improve team efficiency, strengthen project controls, and support effective collaboration across organizations and workstreams.

  

  

**Qualifications**


* 3\+ years as an experienced Project Manager, preferably with experience leading complex business, technology, or enterprise transformation initiatives.
* Certified Associate Project Manager (CAPM), Project Management Professional (PMP), PRINCE2 or other industry\-recognized Project Management accreditation is considered an asset.
* Experience utilizing an extensive knowledge of project methodologies, processes, and practices to effectively deliver business and/or technology projects. ITIL knowledge is an asset.
* Demonstrated knowledge and experience managing medium to large, complex projects across the full project lifecycle, including initiatives with multiple stakeholders, vendors, dependencies, and governance requirements.
* Rapidly acquires new knowledge, learns new skills, and applies creative thinking to solve problems while understanding the organization’s vision, purpose and values.
* Proven experience leading cross\-functional teams and coordinating delivery across business and technology workstreams; experience with Agile delivery, Scrum, or hybrid delivery approaches is considered an asset.
* Understanding and experience with Waterfall, Agile, Kanban, Scrum, and hybrid delivery approaches.
* Strong communication, leadership, facilitation, negotiation, and interpersonal skills, with the ability to build trust and alignment across diverse stakeholder groups.
* Effective risk assessment, problem\-solving, decision\-making abilities, and management techniques.
* Ability to work in a highly collaborative virtual team environment and facilitate progress across geographies, partner organizations, vendors, and functional teams.
* Experience with Office 365 tools (PowerPoint, Excel, Teams, Forms) and project management or collaboration tools such as MS Project, Smartsheet, Jira, Miro, Confluence, or equivalent platforms.

  


**Who we are**



You may not be very familiar with WCLC, but you’re almost certainly familiar with the products we help bring to players throughout the Prairie Provinces and the North every day; lottery games like LOTTO 6/49, SPORT SELECT, and dozens of instant scratch tickets.



WCLC is the non\-profit organization authorized to manage, conduct, and operate lotteries – at retail and online – and other gaming\-related activities for the governments of Alberta, Saskatchewan, and Manitoba as well as the Yukon, Northwest Territories, and Nunavut. We entertain our players while building the future of lottery – delivering innovative, responsible, and trusted experiences that provide growing value for our provinces and territories



We know it’s our people that make this possible, which is why we invest in building talented, adaptable, and accountable teams who are proud to live and work in our region. We offer a challenging, collaborative work environment, competitive benefits, and a good work\-life balance.

  



We’d love to talk to you about how you fit into that.

title: Security Operations Analyst
description:
**Ready for a challenge?**

Just Eat Takeaway is one of the world's leading online food delivery marketplaces, connecting millions of customers with hundreds of thousands of restaurant partners across multiple continents. Operating at significant scale across markets including the UK, Canada, Australia, and Europe, we depend on robust and resilient security operations to protect our customers, partners, and platform. Our Security Operations team sits at the heart of that mission — detecting, investigating, and responding to threats that matter.

 **About this role**


Our Cyber Security Operations Centre (CSOC) is a fully internal team responsible for threat detection, investigation, and incident response. The CSOC's mission centres on threat investigation and continuously refining the organisation's ability to detect and respond to incidents — catching threats early to mitigate and minimise impact. The team works with an advanced toolset anchored by Palo Alto XSIAM as the SIEM and investigation platform, drawing on telemetry from a wide range of sources including endpoint agents, cloud infrastructure, network controls, and application\-layer signals from platforms such as Cloudflare.


We are building towards a modern, AI\-augmented CSOC — one where agentic investigation pipelines handle first\-pass triage and analysis, and our analysts focus on validation, quality assurance, and complex threat investigation. This role requires analytical thinking, a willingness to work with and improve automated systems, and genuine curiosity about how threats manifest in cloud\-native environments.


A CSOC Analyst is an independently operating practitioner: someone who can own incidents end\-to\-end, write and maintain detection content, critically assess the conclusions of AI\-driven investigation pipelines, and act as a capable on\-call responder. This role is ideal for an analyst with solid foundations who is ready to take on greater ownership and is growing towards a senior or specialist track.

*Location: Calgary, Winnipeg or Toronto*

*Reporting to: Technology Manager , CSOC*

**These are some of the key ingredients to the role:**

* Triage, investigate, and analyse security incidents — own alerts from initial triage through to resolution or escalation, working within XSIAM as the primary investigation and case management platform

* Validate agentic investigation conclusions — review, challenge, and provide structured feedback on AI\-driven investigation outputs; identify false positives, missed signals, or incorrect conclusions, and feed insights back to improve automated pipeline quality

* Write and maintain playbooks — author, review, and iterate on detection and response playbooks; ensure playbooks reflect current threat landscape, tooling, and team processes; follow playbooks consistently during incident response

* Implement and tune correlation rules — develop and refine XSIAM correlation rules to improve detection fidelity; reduce false positive rates through systematic tuning; document changes and rationale

* Handle cloud security incidents — investigate incidents originating in or involving cloud infrastructure (AWS, GCP, or Azure); understand cloud\-native attack paths, misconfigurations, and threat indicators

* Participate in the on\-call rota — share on\-call responsibility with the wider team; respond to critical and high\-severity incidents outside business hours in line with defined SLAs

* Contribute to threat detection improvement — proactively identify detection gaps, propose new use cases, and collaborate with Security Engineering to implement them

* Support threat intelligence operationalisation — apply threat intelligence to detection, investigation, and hunting activities; consume and act on intelligence from internal and external sources

 **What will you bring to the table?**


For this role we need an independently competent analyst who requires minimal day\-to\-day direction and demonstrates consistent quality across core responsibilities.

**Skills and Experience:**

* SIEM and investigation platform proficiency — hands\-on experience working in a SIEM for alert triage, investigation, and case management; familiarity with query languages used for log analysis (XQL, KQL, SPL, or equivalent)

* Incident response competency — demonstrable experience investigating and responding to security incidents across a range of alert types (endpoint, network, identity, cloud); ability to follow and apply structured response methodologies

* Detection engineering foundations — experience writing or tuning detection rules, correlation logic, or detection\-as\-code; understanding of what makes a detection effective and how to reduce noise

* Cloud security knowledge — practical understanding of cloud environments (AWS, GCP, or Azure) as they relate to security; experience investigating cloud security incidents or misconfigurations

* Endpoint telemetry analysis — ability to interpret endpoint telemetry during investigations; familiarity with the types of signals and indicators surfaced by endpoint agents

* Playbook literacy — experience following formal incident response playbooks; ideally, experience writing or reviewing them

* Analytical judgement — ability to critically evaluate evidence, assess confidence in conclusions, and make sound decisions with incomplete information

* Communication — clear written communication; able to document investigations, produce concise incident summaries, and brief stakeholders appropriately

* Ownership and accountability — takes end\-to\-end ownership of assigned incidents and tasks; follows through without requiring frequent prompting; flags blockers proactively

**Desirables/Nice to haves**

* Direct experience with Palo Alto XSIAM or Cortex XDR — familiarity with the platform we use day\-to\-day
* Cloud security certification — AWS Security Specialty, GCP Professional Cloud Security Engineer, or equivalent
* Experience with agentic or AI\-assisted security tooling — prior exposure to AI\-driven investigation or SOAR platforms, and an understanding of their limitations
* Threat intelligence experience — familiarity with structured threat intel (MITRE ATT\&CK, STIX/TAXII, threat feeds) and how to operationalise it
* Scripting or automation skills — Python, Bash, or similar; ability to write simple automation or tooling to support investigations
* Experience in a food delivery, e\-commerce, or high\-scale consumer platform environment
* Relevant certifications: GCIA, GCIH, GCFE, SC\-200, or similar

**What We Offer:**

Team Vibes: Thrive in a collaborative culture where your ideas matter.


Tasty Perk: Enjoy a monthly Skip spend allowance – treat yourself!


More Time Off: Generous PTO with a buy and sell program with up to 5 extra days!


Family First: Up to 20 weeks top up for parental leave.


Premium Benefits: Flexible medical \& dental insurance for you and your family.


Keep Learning: Access world\-class training resources to power your success.


Perks Galore: Exclusive offers from Workperks from hundreds of top brands.


Future Funded: RRSP contributions with diverse investment portfolios.


We’ve Got You: We’ve got you covered. Access paid sick time to care for yourself or your family when life happens \& access to our well\-being support programs.


Digital Nomads: Family abroad or just want a change of scenery? Enjoy the freedom to work from almost anywhere in the world for 4 weeks a year.


Career Growth: Fuel your personal and professional evolution through our dedicated mentorship, global mobility pathways, and a wellness\-first culture rooted in true diversity and inclusion.

*Compensation range: $79,440\.00 \- $88,800\.00*

*Final compensation may vary based on skills, experience, and internal equity.*

description:
Senior Research Assistants are normally graduate students, or University of Winnipeg undergraduate students, employed to assist in the execution and evaluation of research projects in their area of study. The positions may oversee Research Assistants in areas such as the use of proper techniques, analysis, and documentation.



Senior Research Assistants work under the general supervision or direction of more senior researchers or faculty members, and are expected to exercise judgment in prioritizing, planning and organizing their own work within defined parameters.


**Position Overview:**



The Sr. Research Assistant will support a community\-engaged research project focused on homelessness prevention, housing instability, service disengagement, safety, and the responsible use of artificial intelligence (AI) in social\-service settings. The project aims to develop evidence\-informed and ethically grounded AI approaches to help identify patterns of homelessness service disengagement and support timely, human\-supervised outreach for people experiencing or at risk of homelessness.  

The Sr. Research Assistant will work with the research team and community partners to support activities such as literature review, data preparation, qualitative and/or quantitative analysis, AI model development or evaluation, documentation, ethics and governance materials, and knowledge translation. The position involves working with homelessness service data, reviewing research on AI for health and social services, supporting the development of predictive or decision\-support models, preparing summaries for community and policy audiences, and contributing to reports, presentations, and academic outputs.  

This role is well suited for a student or early\-career researcher interested in applied AI, homelessness, health and social inequities, or responsible data science. The successful candidate will be expected to work carefully with sensitive topics and data, maintain confidentiality, and contribute to AI\-supported research that is transparent, equity\-oriented, human\-supervised, and useful to service providers and communities.

  

**Duties:**


* Prepare and organize research materials for the artificial intelligence (AI)\-enabled homelessness service disengagement project, including literature review files, data dictionaries, analysis logs, model evaluation templates, and Research Data Centre (RDC) documentation.
* Conduct literature reviews on homelessness prevention, housing instability, service disengagement, victimization, homicide, mortality, responsible AI, machine learning, Indigenous data governance, and the First Nations principles of Ownership, Control, Access, and Possession (OCAP®).
* Assist with preparation, cleaning, documentation, and analysis of de\-identified Homeless Individuals and Families Information System (HIFIS)/Mozaics data and approved Statistics Canada RDC datasets.
* Support quantitative analysis, statistical modelling, machine learning model development, model validation, fairness auditing, and interpretation of findings under the supervision of the Principal Investigator (PI) and research team.
* Assist with development and evaluation of Retrieval\-Augmented Generation (RAG) and multi\-agent AI workflows for homelessness service disengagement detection and decision support.
* Maintain clear research records, including data\-processing notes, analytic decisions, code/output logs, meeting notes, progress updates, and disclosure\-vetted RDC output documentation.
* Assist with preparation of ethics, governance, funding, and partner\-reporting materials, including documents related to confidentiality, responsible AI, and Indigenous data governance.
* Contribute to manuscripts, technical reports, conference presentations, plain\-language summaries, partner briefings, and knowledge\-mobilization materials.
* Help coordinate communication with project partners, including Siloam Mission, Let’s Give Together (LGT)/Mozaics, Main Street Project, research collaborators, and RDC/Statistics Canada contacts as appropriate.
* Support routine project administration, including scheduling meetings, preparing agendas and minutes, tracking deadlines, organizing files, assisting with budget tracking, and performing other research\-related duties as assigned.
  


**Qualifications:**


* Completion of, or current enrolment in, a graduate program is preferred. Strong senior undergraduate students may be considered if they have relevant research or data\-analysis experience.
* Preferred areas of study include computer science, data science, statistics, public health, social work, sociology, criminology, psychology, Indigenous studies, health sciences, public policy, or a related field.
* Coursework or demonstrated training in research methods, statistics, data analysis, machine learning, artificial intelligence (AI), social policy, community\-based research, or Indigenous data governance is an asset.
* Experience with quantitative research, qualitative research, literature reviews, or applied data analysis is preferred.
* No minimum grade in a specific course is required, but applicants should demonstrate strong academic standing and the ability to work independently on research tasks.
* Experience with data analysis software such as R, Python.
* Strong skills in Microsoft Excel, Word, PowerPoint, and reference\-management software such as Mendeley.
* Familiarity with quantitative research methods, statistical modelling, data cleaning, data documentation, and reproducible research workflows.
* Experience in machine learning, artificial intelligence (AI), model evaluation, fairness auditing, and predictive analytics is an asset.
* Familiarity with literature review methods, policy document analysis, or knowledge synthesis is an asset.
* Ability to work with sensitive data and follow confidentiality, ethics, Research Data Centre (RDC), and data\-governance requirements.
* Strong written communication skills, attention to detail, organizational skills, and ability to document research decisions clearly.
* Experience with homelessness, housing, health, social\-service, justice, or administrative data is an asset.


**Condition(s) of Employment:**


* **Must be legally entitled to work in Canada.**
  


The period of work will be from **September 1, 2026 \- August 31, 2027**, and the estimated total hours of work will be **1560 hours**.


***Note****: This position is represented by the Public Service Alliance of Canada \- Research Capacity Unit.*


**Note:** The work described in this posting will be conducted in\-person.

Duties are performed through the use of equipment, auditing techniques, inspection, and testing method. In addition, responsible for HACCP and PQMS program support, CCP verification, and documentation management.

* Perform preventative maintenance and calibration of laboratory and plant analytical equipment.
* Organize, test and communicate test results for various product trials that require chemical or microbiological testing.
* Monitor the release of finished product and ensure nonconforming product is not released in accordance with PQMS program and procedures.
* Perform administrative duties such as maintain records, forms and logs including computer databases, and performing regular inventory checks and providing the Quality Supervisor with a list of required supplies.
* Participant in Health \& Safety Program where applicable.

* Two (2\) to three (3\) years’ experience in a dairy food lab
* Knowledge of analytical and microbiological testing with respect to dairy food products and ability to problem solve
* Ability to work independently and in a team environment
* Organizational and time management skills
* Good communication skills

**Research Associates:**



Under the general direction of, and in collaboration with researchers and faculty members, positions at this level apply extensive knowledge in their field to perform high\-level, complex research activities, and will normally hold a Master’s degree. Individuals with training beyond a Master’s degree who have limited experience may also be appointed into this classification level.


**Position Overview:**



This is a part\-time position for a Research Associate to support the work of the Manitoba Consortium for Digital Agriculture (MCDA or the “consortium”) as project manager (PM). To advance digital ag, the consortium engages researchers from all major institutions across the province. Its work will span the full agricultural value chain, from seeding to market, conducting applied and interdisciplinary research.



The PM will play a pivotal role in evolving MCDA into a unified, province\-wide hub that connects researchers and organizations at all levels of digital agriculture, fostering collaboration, innovation and impact. The PM will be responsible for the day\-to\-day management of resources, budgeting, and reporting. This position will start at a part\-time position at the Research Associate level.


**Duties and Responsibilities:**



Under the supervision of Drs. Beck and Bidinosti, the PM will be responsible for advancing the MCDA through the following key activities:


* **Project management:** Track MCDA’s project progress. Support MCDA’s Industry and Funding Partner Liaison (IFPL) with the identification, monitoring, and tracking of relevant funding opportunities. Keep track of intake deadlines. Support project closing steps. Manage partner and team meetings (plan meetings, coordinate attendance, report and follow\-up on relevant points). Keep track of MCDA collaborative projects, report progress, and lead teams to meet project goals. Identify and clearly communicate project goals, deliverables, and set corresponding timelines. Identify potential risks or blockers on projects. Evaluate project performance and develop corrective actions.
* **Hiring support:** Support equitable and fair hiring processes for Highly Qualified Personnel at all levels and the onboarding process.
* **Reporting:** Create and maintain detailed project documentation and reports. Track MCDA’s accounts, allocate resources to projects, personnel recruitment, equipment, and other expenses. Prepare reports on current projects for funder’s, grant agencies, and stakeholders to ensure financial compliance Prepare MCDA annual reports.
* **Event Coordination:** Coordinate with the consortium’s IFPL in organising roundtables and forums led by the MCDA, including the MCDA’s annual symposium. A particular focus of these events lies on knowledge mobilization, knowledge transfer, and commercialization of research results. This includes:
	+ Help create detailed schedules and manage event logistics as required.
	+ Establish, monitor and adhere to budget allocation to ensure cost\-effectiveness.
	+ Support and supervise event set up, tear\-down, and feedback operations.
	+ Act as the primary point of contact for event attendees.
	+ Manage event attendance (attendees’ registration and presenters), secure venues, and promote events.
	+ Track expenses to ensure remaining within budget.
* **Support Research and Operational Funding:** In coordination with the IFPL, identify new partners, secure relevant funding opportunities, and explore emerging digital technologies within the province.
* **Foster uptake of technology**: In coordination with the IFPL, promote MCDA events and distribute promotional materials. Actively participate in promoting the consortium, e.g., organizing lab tours for MCDA potential partners promoting research findings and new technology through different stakeholder programs.


To fulfill these goals the PM’s duties are as follows:


* Prepare information and material to present project updates to stakeholders.
* Co\-organize and help coordinate seminars, community meetings, and other forms of engagement events.
* Support hiring processes for highly qualified personal at all levels by creating an onboarding manual and corresponding onboarding evaluation survey for academic partners.
* Create and maintain tracking systems, including annual progress reports.
* Conduct project management of collaborative projects.
* Perform other duties, including administrative support, as required or assigned.

* Master’s degree (should specify the field of the degree), or advanced education with appropriate work experience. In case of a specialization very well aligned with digital agriculture a Bachelor’s degree will also be considered.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to translate complex technical concepts (e.g., digital agriculture, precision agriculture, remote sensing, IoT, AI, and machine learning) into compelling, well\-structured stories to foster uptake technology.
* Experience in managing funded projects, including developing and monitoring work plans, milestones, and budgets.
* Experience in preparing and submitting reports to funding agencies.
* Ability to track funding opportunities.
* Ability to organise, plan, and execute research events.
* Ability to engage with technical and non\-technical audiences.
* Ability to create strong networks.


The **optimal candidate** further has:


* Undergraduate or Graduate\-level education (Master’s degree preferred) in agriculture and/or a specialization aligned with digital agriculture.
* Knowledge of the agriculture landscape in Manitoba, Canada, or worldwide.
* Excellent time management skills to keep track of and progress several projects simultaneously.
* Experience in managing multi\-stakeholder and/or interdisciplinary projects.
* Experience in preparing and conducting professional events (e.g., symposia, workshops, focus groups)
* Experience with creating onboarding material for new hires
* Enthusiasm and excitement for digital agriculture and building Manitoba’s capacity in this space

Leveraging their business experiences and knowledge, the Business Operations Analyst will then identify improvements opportunities and help to implement process changes and/or technology solutions to further reduce \& mitigate risks, create efficiencies, reduce operational costs, and enhance the overall satisfaction of our internal stakeholders and users. **WHY YOU SHOULD CHOOSE PAYWORKS**

collection and integration, and operationalization for both everyday AI (optimization) and future AI (innovation). Further, this role will

The Data Science Officer is expected to be visionary and strategic with an ability to turn innovative ideas for the utility industry into

enterprise policies and strategies to leverage ML and AI to achieve business outcomes. There is a clear expectation that ML and AI

**Job Summary:**

We currently have an open position for a QA/QC Technician to join our team on a rotational shift (7:00 am – 3:30 pm and 2:30 pm – 11:00 pm). This role is responsible for receiving, labeling, and testing samples and products formulated in the facility. This role involves operating various laboratory instruments, performing quality control (QC) and quality assurance (QA) tests, and ensuring compliance with Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) and safety regulations.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Conduct various laboratory testing procedures in accordance with SOPs to verify product quality and compliance
* Handle and operate sensitive laboratory instruments, including but not limited to: Gas Chromatography (GC)), Liquid Chromatography (LC, HPLC), pH meters, Analytical balances, Viscometers, Titration equipment, Moisture analyzers (if applicable), Density meters and Karl Fischer Titrators
* Perform sample preparation, testing, and data interpretation with precision and accuracy
* Record all test results and analytical data in the designated formats
* Maintain and update equipment records and daily laboratory logbooks
* Ensure proper calibration, performance verification, and routine maintenance of laboratory instruments according to established procedures
* Assist with method validation, verification, and laboratory procedure updates under supervision
* Perform laboratory supplies inventory and communicate the needs to the supervisor
* Review customer manuals, product specifications, and other documented customer requirements prior to the start of each production campaign to ensure product quality and compliance with agreed specifications
* Prepare, review, update, and issue production documentation, including packaging batch sheets and formulation/blend sheets, ensuring proper version control and alignment with approved formulations and quality requirements
* Review production batch records, test reports, certificates of analysis (COA), and other quality documents for completeness, accuracy, and compliance with internal procedures and regulatory requirements
* Support QA documentation activities including document control, SOP creation and updates, quality records management, and controlled document distribution
* Participate in internal quality audits, compliance checks, and continuous improvement initiatives related to laboratory and quality systems
* Assist in investigations of non\-conforming results, and quality deviations, including documentation of findings and corrective actions
* Ensure laboratory compliance with applicable quality systems and standards such as Croplife and AWSA standards and ISO 9001 Quality Management System
* Follow all laboratory safety protocols, including proper handling of corrosive, flammable, and hazardous chemicals
* Maintain a clean, organized, and efficient laboratory environment in accordance with company policies
* Collaborate with the QA/QC team and production staff to address quality\-related concerns
* Perform other duties related to quality control testing, quality assurance documentation, and laboratory operations as required

**Required Knowledge and Skills:**

* College Diploma or University Degree in Chemistry, Biochemistry, or a Lab Technician Program
* Minimum 1 year of previous lab experience in operating GC and HPLC required
* Understanding of laboratory quality control programs and compliance requirements
* Ability to operate, maintain, and troubleshoot laboratory instruments
* Strong analytical mindset with the ability to follow SOPs precisely
* Proficiency in MS Office (especially Excel) for data analysis; strong mathematical knowledge is an asset
* Strong written and verbal communication skills for reporting and collaboration
* Ability to prioritize tasks, manage multiple responsibilities, and meet deadlines in a fast\-paced environment
* A proactive and trustworthy individual who can work independently and within a team

**Working Conditions:**

* Given the nature of production, this position has a shift rotation (day and evening)
* Work is performed in both a laboratory and a busy plant facility
* Must be able to lift at least 25lbs occasionally
* Prolonged periods of standing and conducting tests may be necessary
* Overtime, as required

Safety is our priority and is both the starting point and foundation for all aspects of our business. Safe transport and storage of products, safe operational practices, and safe working conditions enable us to protect our employees, customers, suppliers, and the environment.

**Position Overview:**



This project maps and studies the various intersections between Holocaust memory and representations of genocidal atrocities in African contexts. description:
We have an opportunity for an Integration Quality Assurance Analyst with experience in software testing to join our team at Western Canada Lottery Corporation (WCLC) in Winnipeg.



In collaboration with internal and external developers and project leads, you will play an instrumental role in the software development life cycle through testing strategies, plans and scenarios, and analyzing the business and functional requirements. This role is specifically focused on delivering high quality integration with API/Service software applications.
  

  

This is a hybrid role, which will work both in the office and remotely from home.


**Key Responsibilities:**


* Design, execute, and maintain integration tests throughout the development lifecycle using both manual and automated testing frameworks.
* Lead the development and enhancement of automated API testing frameworks within the QA environment, with a focus on Boomi iPaaS integrations.
* Build and maintain robust automated test suites to validate API functionality, ensure error handling, and verify business logic across integration layers.
* Create, execute, and manage detailed test cases and test suites; document QA procedures and maintain comprehensive testing records.
* Work with Azure\-based environments to support deployment, testing, and configuration of integration services.
* Conduct integration and regression testing for web services and integrated applications. Support user acceptance testing (UAT) and facilitate product demonstrations for stakeholders.
* Participate actively in Agile scrum ceremonies; advocate for QA best practices and contribute to process improvements.
* Review software specifications and user stories to define comprehensive test plans aligned with business requirements.
* Collaborate closely with the Application Delivery team and external partners to ensure testing coverage across integrated systems.
* Analyze and interpret test results, log and manage defects, and conduct root\-cause analysis in collaboration with developers and business analysts.
* Validate structured data formats, including XML/JSON payloads, ensuring proper schema validation and transformations across integration layers.
* Develop and execute database validation queries (T\-SQL) to verify data integrity across integrated systems.
* Administer and troubleshoot test environments in Linux, including connectivity, system backups, data setup, and access to integration services.
* Manage and maintain QA testing environments, including test data, environment configuration, version control, and deployment processes in the QA environment.
* Continuously develop expertise in software business processes, stay informed on emerging technologies, and apply QA best practices to integration testing.


**Qualifications and Competencies:**


* Post\-secondary education in Computer Science, Engineering, Software Quality Assurance, or a related field.
* 2\+ years of experience in API testing and automated testing frameworks.
* 2\+ years of hands\-on experience in software QA, with a strong focus on integration and automation testing.
* Working knowledge of Boomi Integration Platform as a Service (iPaaS) and its testing capabilities is highly preferred.
* Proficient in ReadyAPI (including SoapUI), with hands\-on experience using tools and languages such as GroovyScript and Bitbucket/GitHub. Experience in Postman is also an asset
* Strong experience testing within Linux and Cloud\-based test environments, including working with SQL and relational databases.
* Hands\-on experience with T\-SQL and database validation techniques to support integration testing.
* Working knowledge of XML/JSON, including schema validation, transformations, and API payload validation.
* Familiarity with Microsoft Azure environments and experience working with cloud\-based integration services.
* ISTQB Certification (or equivalent QA certification) is preferred.
* Excellent organizational skills, with the ability to manage multiple assignments, prioritize tasks, and maintain detailed documentation.
* Strong analytical, verbal, and written communication skills.
* Proven ability to thrive in a team\-oriented, fast\-paced Agile environment.


We offer a challenging, team\-oriented work environment, competitive income and benefits, and a good work\-life balance.

  


**Who we are**



You may not be very familiar with WCLC, but you’re almost certainly familiar with the products we help bring to players throughout the Prairie Provinces and the North every day; lottery games like LOTTO 6/49, SPORT SELECT, and dozens of instant scratch tickets.



WCLC is the non\-profit organization authorized to manage, conduct, and operate lotteries – at retail and online – and other gaming\-related activities for the governments of Alberta, Saskatchewan, and Manitoba as well as the Yukon, Northwest Territories, and Nunavut. We entertain our players while building the future of lottery – delivering innovative, responsible, and trusted experiences that provide growing value for our provinces and territories



We know it’s our people that make this possible, which is why we invest in building talented, adaptable, and accountable teams who are proud to live and work in our region. We offer a challenging, collaborative work environment, competitive benefits, and a good work\-life balance.

Reporting to the Manager, HR Systems, the HRMS Report Analyst is responsible for the development, design, building, testing, implementation, and maintenance of a suite of HRMS reports, analytic indicators and advanced configurations in various HR solutions. title: Data Privacy and Records Analyst, Data Privacy and Compliance Office
description:
The Data Privacy and Compliance Office is responsible for developing and operating UWinnipeg’s data privacy/compliance program that coordinates and implements multiple functions crucial to the overall control of the University’s data, including privacy, access to information, and data/records management.



The **Data Privacy and Records Analyst is a full\-time continuing** position that plays a central role in the delivery and maintenance of the University’s data privacy/compliance program.


**Responsibilities:**


* Analyzes the University’s program areas and operations to identify current activities and practices.
* Generates inventories that capture personal data processing across the University.
* Assists in the design and implementation of data/records classification systems and retention schedules pursuant to the University Records Policy.
* Updates data/records classification systems, retention schedules, and inventories based on changes to operations or legislative requirements.
* Generates records of processing activities to demonstrate how a data subject’s personal data is processed across the University.
* Assists with the completion of data privacy/compliance impact assessments.
* Collaborates with personnel from other University offices in the operation of a University\-wide data governance program.
* Performs research and analysis to identify new projects.
* Provides input and assistance in drafting protocols, guidelines, policies, and memos.
* Receives and coordinates access to information requests.
* Prepares reports and other documents for the Government of Manitoba and the Office of the Manitoba Ombudsman regarding access to information.
* Responds to inquiries from faculty, staff, students, and the public concerning data privacy, data/records management, and access to information.
* Delivers high\-quality training and education to the University community.
* Keeps up\-to\-date on relevant law and compliance requirements.
* Other related duties as assigned.


**Qualifications:**


* Graduate degree in a relevant area preferred; undergraduate degree required.
* Designation from a relevant professional association (e.g., IAPP, PACC) an asset.
* Minimum 3 years of related experience in data privacy, access to information, or data/records management, preferably in a post\-secondary or government environment.
* Experience managing projects throughout their full lifecycle.
* Experience interpreting and applying legislative requirements.
* Experience delivering training and preparing reports, briefing notes, and similar correspondence to internal and external stakeholders.
* Experience interpreting, applying, and enforcing policies.
* Experience working independently and taking initiative.

* Strong oral and written communication skills, including public speaking.
* Demonstrated ability to communicate complex privacy and data/records issues to broad audiences.

You will use financial, statistical, and business\-focused techniques to understand trends, forecast future costs, and solve business problems. You will prioritize competing projects and develop plans of action to support the division in monitoring and controlling physical damage claim costs, operational processes, and resources. You will proactively identifies anomalies and unexpected trends, alerts appropriate management, and provide recommendations on appropriate additional work.

* Develop solutions for moderately complex business problems through detailed business, root cause, cost benefit analysis and feasibility studies.

* Gather requirements, develops, tests, implements, and maintains operational dashboards that help monitor claim cost and operational effectiveness within the Operations division.
* Plan analysis and reports to ensure compliance to physical damage claim business rules and procedures.
* Prepare clear concise reports/presentations outlining findings and recommendations to management within the Operations division along with other key stakeholders within the Operations division.
* Support development of small to large business cases by providing specific knowledge and expertise, cost\-benefit analysis, decision making, RFP development and response evaluation and success monitoring.

OR* Degree in Commerce, Statistics, Economics, Computer Science, Accounting, Finance, or a related discipline.

description:
**Winpak Division** is seeking an **Project Sales Specialist** to join our **Latin America Customer Service Team** based in **Winnipeg, Manitoba**. **Ability to communicate fluently in Spanish and English is required for this role.**



The **Project Sales Specialist** plays a key role in delivering exceptional customer support and driving business success across Mexico, Central America, and South America. Reporting to the Manager, Sales Support \& Customer Service, Latin America, you will serve as the primary link between customers, distributors, and Winpak and Wipak business units, ensuring seamless communication, coordinating customer initiatives, and supporting new product launches.



If you're a detail oriented, proactive, customer\-focused professional who thrives in a collaborative environment and enjoys solving problems, we'd love to have you join our team!


**Key Responsibilities**


* Serve as the primary point of contact for customers and distributors across Latin America, providing exceptional service and timely support.
* Manage customer orders, pricing, quotations, artwork requests, product samples, and credit/debit requests from receipt through completion.
* Coordinate customer projects, new product launches, and product changes, ensuring deadlines and customer expectations are met.
* Build strong relationships with key accounts and collaborate with R\&D, Purchasing, Planning, Production, and Shipping teams to resolve issues and support business needs.
* Work with Sales Representatives and internal stakeholders to address customer inquiries, complaints, and account\-related requests.
* Collaborate with planning, supply chain, and logistics teams to coordinate shipments, manage inventory, and ensure uninterrupted product supply.
* Analyze customer opportunities and recommend the most suitable business unit to support project success.
* Support pricing updates, contract administration, forecasting, and, when required, assist with customer receivables.
* Lead cross\-functional communication and collaborate with internal teams to drive continuous improvement and operational excellence.
* Ensure compliance with company policies, ISO 9001 standards, and Winpak's Total Quality program while supporting special projects and occasional travel as required.


**Required Qualifications**


* 3\+ years of experience in a role requiring strong verbal and written communication skills in **English and Spanish**, with the ability to communicate information clearly, professionally, and effectively while building positive relationships with both internal and external stakeholders.
* 5\+ years of experience in a manufacturing environment, including at least 2 years managing a sales territory.
* 5\+ years of experience working in a customer\-focused and cross\-functional environment, preferably within manufacturing, supply chain, packaging, or operations.
* 3\+ years of experience in a role that required managing multiple priorities, coordination of competing deadlines, and maintenance of a high level of accuracy and attention to detail.
* 2\+ years of experience using Microsoft Office applications including Outlook, Word, Excel, and Teams.
* 2\+ years of experience using ERP and/or CRM systems to manage customer information, orders, inventory, or business transactions.


**Preferred Qualifications**


* Post\-secondary education in Business, Sales, or a related field is preferred.


**Additional Information**


* This position is fully onsite at 100 Saulteaux Crescent, Winnipeg MB
* Work schedule – Monday to Friday, 8:00am \- 4:30pm


**What do we offer?**



Winpak is committed to providing comprehensive benefits to support the physical, mental and financial well\-being of our employees and their families. Our benefit package includes the following 100% employer paid benefits:


* Medical \& prescription
* Dental
* Vision
* Travel
* Life and accidental death \& dismemberment insurance
* Tuition assistance program
* A comprehensive employee and family assistance program which includes short term counselling, wellbeing coaching, financial and legal consultations services.


Additionally, you can choose to enroll in additional voluntary life insurance for yourself. If you become injured or ill, you will also be able to apply for salary continuance and long\-term disability benefit coverage.


**Why Winpak?**

Winpak’s vision is to provide the best packaging solutions for people and planet. We are a leading supplier of innovative packaging solutions, known for providing high\-quality products that meet the needs of a variety of industries, including food and beverage, pharmaceuticals, and consumer products. With a commitment to sustainability, safety, and excellence, Winpak continues to grow as a global leader in the packaging industry.


**At Winpak, inclusion is one of our core values.** We believe that an inclusive culture fosters a sense of belonging, drives innovation, and provides our brand a competitive advantage. Our goal is to create an environment free from harassment and discrimination, and where every individual feels respected, valued, and appreciated.


**As an Equal Opportunity Employer,** we are committed to an equitable and inclusive recruitment process, evaluating applicants based on merit, capability, and qualifications related to the job \- never on identity factors such as race, color, gender, age, sexual orientation, religion, disability, national origin, or any other protected status. To support this commitment, if you require any accommodations during the recruitment process, please let us know and we will work with you to ensure your needs are met.

***About Tilray Brands, Inc.***

***Tilray Brands, Inc.*** (“Tilray”) (Nasdaq: TLRY; TSX: TLRY), is leading global lifestyle and consumer packaged goods company with operations in Canada, the United States, Europe, Australia, and Latin America that is leading as a transformative force at the nexus of cannabis, beverage, wellness, and entertainment, elevating lives through moments of connection. Tilray’s mission is to be a leading premium lifestyle company with a house of brands and innovative products that inspire joy, wellness and create memorable experiences. Tilray’s unprecedented platform supports over 40 brands in over 20 countries, including comprehensive cannabis offerings, hemp\-based foods, and craft beverages.


**Meet Manitoba Harvest**

Manitoba Harvest is owned by ***Tilray Brands, Inc.*** , a global pioneer in the medical and recreational cannabis industry and hemp foods markets. ***Manitoba Harvest*** *,* the world’s largest hemp foods company, offers a portfolio of hemp foods and wellness products to consumers across North America. Our mission is to transform consumer health through the power of hemp foods.


**REPORTS TO:** Quality Control Manager


**JOB SUMMARY:** The Quality Control Technician ensures that ingredients, packaging materials, work in process, and finished products meet company, government, supplier, customer and third party registrar requirements for quality, food safety, and sanitation.


**Status:** This is for an existing opportunity.


**Work Type:** Temporary 3\-month contract position ending in October 2026\.


**RESPONSIBILITIES:**

* Acts and provides guidance on product sampling and sample submission requirements to Production, Quality, Product Development, Supply Chain, and Third Party Co\-manufacturer team members
* Performs biological, chemical, physical, and organoleptic laboratory testing as per product or environmental specifications
* Translates internal and external laboratory results into a central lab database
* Communicates laboratory testing results to appropriate team members and creates Certificates of Analysis
* Perform analytical work for Research and Development projects as requested
* Maintain and organize the laboratory, laboratory inventory and supplies, lab records, and retention samples
* Participates with internal inspections, internal audits, root cause analysis, documented corrective and preventative actions and risk assessments
* Provides guidance to Production, Quality, Product Development, and Supply Chain regarding food safety programs and requirements (GLPs, BRC, HACCP, GMP, certifications, etc.)
* All team members are responsible to report on food safety and/or quality problems to personnel with the authority to initiate corrective actions
* Other duties as assigned by the organization

COMPETENCIES:


* Accountability
* Adaptability
* Communication
* Analytical Thinking
* Initiative
* Teamwork
* Problem\-solving
* Detail\-oriented
* Decision\-making

QUALIFICATIONS:


* Post\-secondary degree related to Food Science or Nutrition
* Quality Assurance experience in a food manufacturing facility is preferred
* Authoritative knowledge of SOPs, HACCP and GMPs applicable to quality, compliance, and production.
* Knowledge of Good Laboratory Practices (GLP)
* Proficient in Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook)

WORKING CONDITIONS:


* Ability to lift up to 50 pounds
* Sit / stand for long periods of time
* Ability to work alone on a weekend rotation
* Manual dexterity required to use computer and peripherals
* Repetitive laboratory tasks
* Interacts with team members and management

DESIGNATE


* Director, Quality

CONFIDENTIALITY:


* Responsible to preserve and safeguard all confidential information that comes to their knowledge in the course of employment with Fresh Hemp Foods Ltd.
* Responsible to observe and comply with the policies of the Company and applicable legal requirements with respect to confidential information and the protection of privacy

As a member of the facility's FSQA team, the FSQA Coordinator monitors and analyzes data related to all Food Safety, GMP, HACCP and other Quality Assurance Program requirements to ensure they are consistently achieved. title: Sample Intake Technician
description:
**Sample Intake Technician**

**Summary** 

Duracan is seeking a Sample Intake Technician to support our Winnipeg location. This role is responsible for receiving, verifying, and logging client samples, as well as providing administrative, invoicing, and customer service support.

The Sample Intake Technician plays a key role in maintaining accurate sample intake, documentation, and coordination with laboratory operations to ensure sample integrity, traceability, and efficient workflow. This position requires strong attention to detail, organizational skills, professionalism, and the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast\-paced laboratory environment.

**Responsibilities**

**Sample Intake \& Documentation**

* Receive client samples and verify labeling, condition, and documentation.
* Review submission forms for completeness and accuracy.
* Log samples into the laboratory information system with a high degree of accuracy.
* Ensure proper identification, handling, storage, and organization of samples.
* Maintain accurate records to support sample traceability.
* Verify sample acceptance criteria and identify potential issues requiring follow\-up.
* Communicate discrepancies, missing information, or damaged samples to appropriate personnel.
* Maintain sample tracking throughout the intake process.

**Client Service \& Communication**

* Provide front\-desk support for clients submitting samples.
* Greet and assist clients, visitors, and contractors in a professional manner.
* Answer and direct phone calls, emails, and other inquiries.
* Assist clients with submission forms and general inquiries (non\-technical).
* Maintain a professional, courteous, and customer\-focused approach at all times.
* Communicate effectively with laboratory, administrative, and management staff.
* Maintain timely communication regarding sample intake status, issues, and priorities.

**Logistics \& Coordination**

* Assist in coordinating and managing the movement of samples within laboratory operations.
* Prepare samples for internal transfer and ensure proper handling and tracking.
* Coordinate incoming and outgoing courier shipments, mail, packages, and deliveries.
* Maintain organized tracking of incoming and outgoing samples.
* Support communication between departments to ensure efficient sample processing.
* Assist with coordination of outsourced samples and associated documentation when required.

**Administrative Support**

* Perform data entry and maintain accurate records.
* Prepare and process documentation, submission forms, invoices, and related records.
* Assist with invoicing activities and coordination of supporting documentation.
* Maintain organized filing systems, databases, and electronic records.
* Support general administrative and operational tasks as required.
* Maintain an organized, professional, and secure workspace.

**Inventory \& Supplies Management**

* Assist with monitoring office, laboratory, and sample intake supplies.
* Receive, organize, and distribute deliveries and shipments.
* Assist in sourcing office and laboratory supplies from vendors as required.
* Maintain inventory records and communicate supply needs to management.

**Quality \& Compliance**

* Follow company procedures for sample handling, documentation, and intake.
* Identify and report discrepancies, damaged samples, incomplete documentation, or non\-conformances.
* Support quality system requirements related to sample receipt, documentation, and traceability.
* Maintain confidentiality of client, company, and laboratory information.
* Ensure compliance with company policies, procedures, and applicable regulatory requirements.
* Adhere to laboratory safety protocols and use appropriate personal protective equipment (PPE) as required.
* Participate in maintaining a safe work environment by reporting hazards, incidents, or safety concerns.

**Document \& Data Management**

* Prepare and process documents related to sample intake, invoicing, reporting, and administrative activities.
* Perform accurate data entry and maintain databases and software systems.
* Maintain meticulous record\-keeping practices to support quality and traceability requirements.
* Support integration of data into relevant software systems and databases.
* Verify information accuracy and completeness before processing records.

**Invoicing \& Administrative Support**

* Assist in managing invoicing processes and ensuring timely and accurate entries.
* Coordinate with laboratory and administrative departments to obtain information required for invoicing.
* Assist with payment processing and administrative follow\-up when required.
* Support departmental efficiency through accurate documentation and record management.

**Additional Responsibilities**

* Support additional administrative or operational tasks as required.
* Work collaboratively with team members to support daily operations and departmental coverage.
* Assist with training and onboarding activities as required.
* Support continuous improvement initiatives and process enhancements.
* Maintain timely communication with management regarding daily activities, issues, and sample intake status.
* Duties and responsibilities may be adjusted based on operational requirements.

**Qualifications**

* Strong attention to detail and organizational skills.
* Excellent communication and customer service abilities.
* Comfortable with data entry and computer systems.
* Ability to work independently with minimal supervision.
* Ability to prioritize competing tasks in a fast\-paced environment.
* Strong problem\-solving skills and ability to adapt to changing priorities.
* Ability to maintain professionalism and confidentiality.
* Ability to quickly learn new software systems, procedures, and processes.

**Education \& Experience (Assets)**

* Diploma or degree in a relevant field (science, environmental, business, or administration) or equivalent experience is considered an asset.
* Previous administrative, customer service, or laboratory support experience is considered an asset.
* Experience in a laboratory, environmental, or sample intake setting is considered an asset.
* Familiarity with laboratory safety protocols and handling procedures is preferred.

**Additional Skills (Assets)**

* Strong data entry skills with a high level of accuracy.
* Typing speed of 45 WPM or greater is considered an asset.
* Ability to manage multiple tasks and deadlines effectively.
* Proficiency with computer systems and common office software.
* Experience with Mac\-based systems is considered an asset.
* Experience with laboratory information management systems (LIMS) is considered an asset.
* Ability to handle sensitive information with professionalism and discretion.

**Work Environment**

* Office\-based position with regular handling of environmental samples.
* Work may involve handling samples that could contain potentially hazardous materials.
* Frequent standing, walking, lifting, carrying, and moving sample coolers and supplies may be required.
* Adherence to laboratory safety protocols and use of appropriate PPE is required at all times.

**Schedule**

* Monday to Friday
* Overtime as required

**Benefits**

* Casual dress
* Company events
* Benefits
* On\-site parking

**Flexible Language Requirement:**

* French not required

**Supplemental Pay Types:**

* Bonus pay
* Overtime pay

Turning Leaf is a non\-profit, charitable organization that provides person\-centered, crisis and treatment services to low and high\-risk vulnerable and marginalized individuals living with mental illness and intellectual challenge in our community. 420 hours worked
  

For more information please contact: Silvia M. Panameno \- silvia.panameno@umanitoba.ca


**Qualifications**
------------------


**MINIMAL FORMAL EDUCATION REQUIRED:**

* High school completion with job‑related options plus two years \= directly\-related experience.

OR


* Completion of a Community College course in a related discipline with no experience.
* Some post secondary education is preferred.

**EXPIERENCE:**


* Experience with various cell culture models (primary cells), including processing human blood and intestinal biopsy tissue, is required.
* Experience with clinic coordination including using Accuro for screening potential research participants, and consenting participants in person is required.
* Experience with formalin fixed paraffin embedded (FFPE) sectioning and immunohistochemistry and multi\-color immunofluorescence staining of tissues is required.
* Experience working in Containment Level 2 is required. Must demonstrate adherence to strict biosafety protocols.
* Experience with data analysis and presentation using Graphpad Prism, Microsoft Powerpoint, Excel and Word is required.
* Experience with RNA isolation and RT\-qPCR would be an asset.
* Experience in lab organization and inventory management would be an asset.
* An acceptable equivalent combination of education and experience may be considered.

**SKILLS AND ABILITIES:**


* Excellent English oral and written communication skills are required.
* Strong organizational skills, meticulousness, and accuracy are required.
* Strong work ethic, and troubleshooting through reading the literature are required.
* Must be able to demonstrate interpersonal and teamwork skills, but also work independently after training for specific techniques is required.
* Must be well\-organized with data/clinical sample management, typing up lab protocols and keeping up to date with lab notes electronically is required.
* Demonstrated ability to learn new techniques and adapt protocols when needed is required.
* Ability to complete projects within well\-defined time limits is required.
* A satisfactory work record, including satisfactory attendance and punctuality, is required.

**OTHER JOB RELATED QUALIFICATIONS:**
* Must have good eyesight.
* Must have good manual dexterity.
* Must be comfortable working in containment level 2\+ and with human blood and tissues from healthy or diseased patients including being up to date on routine vaccines including hepatitis B.
* Must be willing to approach potential participants in clinic to explain the research project clearly for informed consent after completing necessary privacy and ethics training.
**Key responsibilities**
------------------------


**EXPERIMENT/LAB RESPONSIBILITIES:**
* Process, culture and carry out experiments with cell lines and primary cells from human blood or intestinal tissues.
* Coordinate research with clinics including screening inclusion/exclusion criteria(Accuro software) and in\-person consent of research participants for human studies.
* Perform techniques including ELISA, immunohistochemistry, and confocal microscopy.
* Perform molecular biology techniques including DNA/RNA isolation, real\-time quantitative PCR.
* Complete data analysis including statistics, create figures, and analysis of microscopy images

**MAINTENANCE/ORGANIZATION RESPONSIBILITIES:**
* Help maintain up\-to\-date inventory for fridges, freezers and benchtop.
* Help maintain up\-to\-date human clinical specimen masterlists.
* Help maintain up\-to\-date standard operating procedures.
* Basic lab cleanup, organization and autoclaving waste
**COMMUNICATION RESPONSIBILITIES:**


* Communicate weekly plans and data to supervisor through weekly meetings.
* Prepare and present data at solo or joint lab meetings with standard software (Microsoft Powerpoint, Graphpad Prism).
* Write up results for manuscripts in collaboration with Principal Investigator.
* May be required to perform related duties not exceeding skills and capabilities as required.
