**Qualifications**
------------------



**MINIMAL FORMAL EDUCATION REQUIRED:**


* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Health Informatics, Information Systems, Data Science, Biostatistics, Epidemiology, Engineering, or a related scientific/technological discipline is required.
* Graduate degree would be considered an asset.
* Relevant certifications in database administration, data engineering, information security, cloud technologies, or project management would be considered an asset.
* Formal training in database design, data management, software development, health informatics, or analytics is preferred.

**EXPERIENCE:**


* Minimum of four (4\) years of professional work experience in a role involving one or more of the following: relational databases, data management systems, research data platforms, research electronic data capture (EDC) applications, and/or electronic medical record (EMR) systems.
* Database \& data engineering expertise: Experience designing and maintaining relational databases, developing advanced SQL queries, and building Extract, Transform, and Load (ETL) \& data integration pipelines.
* Programming \& analytics skills: Proficiency in Power BI, Python, R, or similar languages for data processing, cleaning, analysis, reporting, visualization, dashboards, and business intelligence initiatives.
* Healthcare research data experience: Strong experience working with healthcare, clinical, administrative, or research datasets, Fast Healthcare Interoperability Resources (FHIR), electronic medical records, and regulated environments involving privacy, data governance, and identified personal health information.
* Systems Integration \& Quality Assurance: Experience utilizing/developing APIs, web services, server\-side applications, system integrations, computerized system validation (CSV), and software quality assurance practices.
* Collaborative versatility: Experience collaborating with multidisciplinary teams consisting of researchers, clinicians, analysts, and information technology professionals is desirable.
* Cybersecurity and Data Stewardship: Awareness of cybersecurity best practices and experience to incorporating security, role\-based access, and data governance considerations into data and information systems.
* Experience with REDCap is highly valued.
* Additional consideration will be given to otherwise qualified candidates who have experience designing and maintaining web content using HTML, CSS, and JavaScript, as well as working with server\-side web technologies such as HTTP servers and PHP.
* Experience with full\-stack web development is an asset.
* An acceptable equivalent combination of education and experience may be considered.

**SKILLS AND ABILITIES:**


* Practical working knowledge of probability, statistics, and research design is required.
* Strong analytical, critical\-thinking, and problem\-solving skills are required.
* Strong oral and written communication skills, including the ability to translate complex technical concepts and requirements into clear, understandable information for technical and non\-technical stakeholders is required.
* Ability to build and maintain effective working relationships with clients, manage expectations, and respond constructively to concerns are required.
* Commitment to data quality, data integrity, reproducibility, and continuous process improvement is required.
* Leadership, independence, organization, and professional judgment: Ability to work independently with minimal supervision, establish and maintain appropriate practices and procedures, set team priorities, manage multiple demands and time constraints, and exercise sound judgment while ensuring alignment with organizational objectives and applicable policies. Ability to exercise significant independent judgment to train, mentor, coordinate, accept the work of, and delegate tasks to junior staff is required.
* Demonstrated attention to detail, accuracy, written communication, and good word processing skills, as evidenced by the submission of a complete, clear, accurate, concise, effectively formatted, and professionally prepared CV and cover letter that are tailored to the listed requirements of the position is required.
* A satisfactory work record, including satisfactory attendance and punctuality, is required.

  

**Key responsibilities**
------------------------


**Lead the design, development, testing, implementation, and maintenance of database application systems. Provide technical leadership to a sub\-team of data management analysts within the University of Manitoba Data Coordinating Centre, focusing on exercising independent judgment and autonomy when conducting and coordinating the following activities:**
* Lead the design, development, and maintenance of relational databases and REDCap projects supporting operational, administrative, quality improvement, and research activities.
* Develop and manage data integration and Extract, Transform, Load (ETL) processes, including automated ingestion, transformation, normalization, validation, and quality assurance of data from EMRs and other sources.
* Create data products and technical solutions, including server\-side applications, structured datasets, SQL queries, reports, dashboards, analytics, and workflow automation using tools such as Python, PHP, R, APIs, and SQL
* Ensure data governance, privacy, security, and quality compliance, including PHIA requirements, access controls, audit logging, validation processes, and documentation standards.
* Exercise significant independence and judgment in collaborating and consulting with researchers, clinicians, analysts, and stakeholders to translate business and research requirements into technical solutions.
* Provide initiative, training and support when contributing to strategic planning and platform development.
* Improve, write, and finalize Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) and develop associated workflow processes. Exercise independence in enforcing adherence to SOPs.

**Develop reporting standards and procedures for information captured within administrative datasets:**
* Develop flexible reporting systems that can be routinely run on database to uncover insights into how health care system is utilized.
* Performs and directs descriptive analysis, data quality monitoring, query issuing and resolution, data processing, and visualizations of imperfect datasets.

**Project management, delegation, mentorship, and training in research data management:**
* Schedule and co\-ordinate consultation/training events with relevant user and stakeholder groups. Exercises a high degree of judgment and independence of action when consulting with investigators and external project teams.
* Mentors junior team members, delegates tasks, accepts/rejects work, and coordinates the activities of other data management analysts. Applies a high level of independent judgment in training, evaluating, and providing guidance on the work of team members.

* Provides regular reports of project status to the DCC Lead and stakeholders. Effectively communicates project status to the DCC Lead in order to collaboratively assess deliverables, identify opportunities for improvement, and ensure alignment with organizational standards and requirements.

* Stays up to date on current developments in clinical research data management software and applications.

**Norstar Industries Ltd.**
**Rosenort, MB \| Full\-Time**
=====================================================================================


Norstar Industries Ltd. is a family\-owned manufacturer of grain handling equipment and industrial material handling solutions. Based near Rosenort, Manitoba, we design and manufacture innovative products that serve customers across North America and beyond.


We're looking for an experienced **Design Project Manager** to lead and coordinate our design and drafting team while managing the priorities, timelines, and workflow behind the drawings and Bills of Materials that support our manufacturing operation.


This is a hands\-on leadership role for someone who can manage multiple priorities, support a team, and keep design projects moving from assignment through completion.

**What You'll Do**
------------------


Working closely with the Director of Design, you will oversee the coordination, progress, and quality of design projects.

### **Manage Projects \& Timelines**

* Receive project priorities and direction from the Director of Design.
* Assign design and drafting projects based on team workload, priorities, and deadlines.
* Establish clear milestones, timelines, and due dates for drawings and Bills of Materials.
* Track project progress and identify potential delays or challenges.
* Conduct regular progress reviews and provide updates to the Director of Design.
* Help ensure drawings and BOMs are completed accurately and on schedule.

### **Lead \& Support the Design Team**

* Conduct regular check\-ins to monitor workload, provide support, and resolve issues.
* Provide hands\-on design guidance, technical support, and constructive feedback.
* Mentor team members and support their professional development.
* Conduct performance reviews for drafting staff.
* Assist with recruiting, interviewing, and onboarding new team members.
* Foster accountability, collaboration, and effective communication within the team.

### **Coordinate \& Maintain Quality**

* Work with Sales, Production, and leadership to maintain alignment on project priorities, timelines, and feasibility.
* Assist with project meetings and communicate changes or issues that may affect completion.
* Support the development and maintenance of design protocols and documentation standards.
* Conduct design reviews to help ensure work meets quality, functionality, and manufacturability standards.
* Identify opportunities to improve workflows and project coordination.

**What We're Looking For**
--------------------------

* Previous experience managing or supervising a design or drafting team is required.
* Strong project management, organizational, and time management skills.
* Experience with **3D CAD design and Autodesk Inventor** is a strong asset. AutoCAD experience alone is not sufficient for this role.
* Ability to manage multiple projects, priorities, and deadlines.
* Strong communication, leadership, and problem\-solving skills.
* Experience in manufacturing and design is an asset.
* Understanding of basic manufacturing principles.
* Strong computer skills, including Microsoft Office and Autodesk Inventor.
* Completion of a Mechanical Technology program is an asset but not required.
* Experience with grain handling equipment is an asset.
* Strong attention to detail and ability to work effectively in a busy environment.
* Ability to work independently and collaboratively with multiple departments.

**What Success Looks Like**
---------------------------


Success in this role means becoming a trusted leader who keeps Norstar's design projects organized and moving forward.


You will:

* Establish clear priorities, milestones, and timelines for design projects.
* Ensure drawings and Bills of Materials are completed accurately and within established timelines.
* Maintain visibility into project progress and proactively address issues that could affect deadlines.
* Build a collaborative and accountable design team.
* Provide meaningful guidance and support that helps team members develop their skills.
* Improve communication between Design, Sales, Production, and Leadership.
* Maintain Norstar's design and documentation standards.
* Identify opportunities to improve workflows and reduce inefficiencies.

**Why Join Norstar?**
---------------------

* Competitive salary commensurate with experience and qualifications
* Comprehensive benefits package
* Full\-time, permanent career opportunity
* Stable, family\-owned company
* Opportunity to lead and develop a growing design team
* Collaborative leadership environment
* Opportunities for professional growth and advancement


At Norstar, we're proud to build products that help feed the world. We believe exceptional products start with exceptional people, and we're committed to creating an environment where our employees can grow, contribute, and succeed together.

**Apply today and help lead the people, projects, and processes behind Norstar's innovative products.**

description:
**Benefits:**
* Competitive salary
* Health insurance
* Opportunity for advancement
Help Keep Projects Moving. Help Customers Through Difficult Moments.  

At ServiceMaster Restore of Winnipeg, we help people through some of the most challenging situations they'll ever face. When a home or business suffers damage from water, fire, mould, or other disasters, our team works together to restore not only the property, but also peace of mind.  

We're looking for a **Project Coordinator** who thrives on staying organized, supporting others, and keeping moving parts aligned. You'll work closely with our Project Managers, field teams, customers, and partners to help ensure projects run smoothly and customers feel informed throughout the restoration process.  

This is more than an administrative role. You'll play an important part in helping our team deliver exceptional service while supporting customers during a difficult time.  

What You'll Do  

* Support Project Managers in coordinating restoration projects from start to finish.
* Communicate with customers, insurance partners, subcontractors, and team members.
* Help keep schedules, job files, and project documentation organized and up to date.
* Monitor project progress and help ensure important information is communicated to the right people.
* Assist with customer updates and help create a positive customer experience.
* Support compliance, reporting, and administrative requirements throughout the life of a project.
* Help identify potential issues and ensure they are brought forward for resolution.
* Work closely with multiple departments to keep projects moving efficiently.

What We're Looking For  

* Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.
* Excellent communication and customer service abilities.
* A positive attitude and willingness to help wherever needed.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast\-paced environment.
* Strong follow\-through and a commitment to getting things done.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office, particularly Outlook and Excel.
* Experience in administration, customer service, coordination, construction, restoration, insurance, or project support roles.

Assets That Will Set You Apart  

* Experience in restoration, construction, insurance, or property claims.
* Experience supporting multiple projects or teams simultaneously.
* Familiarity with project management or job management software.
* Strong documentation and file management skills.

Why Work With Us  

* Competitive compensation based on experience.
* Company\-paid benefits for qualifying employees.
* Ongoing training and development opportunities.
* Opportunities for growth and increased responsibility.
* A supportive team environment where people work together to achieve common goals.
* Meaningful work helping customers recover from unexpected property damage.

About ServiceMaster Restore of Winnipeg  

We restore homes, businesses, and peace of mind following water, fire, mould, and other property damage losses. Our team is committed to delivering exceptional service while supporting customers through some of life's most challenging moments.  

Apply Today  

If you're organized, dependable, and enjoy supporting a team while helping customers through difficult situations, we'd love to hear from you.

*This franchise is independently owned and operated by a franchisee. Your application will go directly to the franchisee, and all hiring decisions will be made by the management of this franchisee. All inquiries about employment at this franchisee should be made directly to the franchise location, and not to The ServiceMaster Company, LLC.*

**Job details**
---------------


Research Data Systems Technical Lead \- IT5 (AESES)

840 hours worked

**Qualifications**
------------------



**MINIMAL FORMAL EDUCATION REQUIRED:**


* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Health Informatics, Information Systems, Data Science, Biostatistics, Epidemiology, Engineering, or a related scientific/technological discipline is required.
* Graduate degree would be considered an asset.
* Relevant certifications in database administration, data engineering, information security, cloud technologies, or project management would be considered an asset.
* Formal training in database design, data management, software development, health informatics, or analytics is preferred.

**EXPERIENCE:**


* Minimum of four (4\) years of professional work experience in a role involving one or more of the following: relational databases, data management systems, research data platforms, research electronic data capture (EDC) applications, and/or electronic medical record (EMR) systems.
* Database \& data engineering expertise: Experience designing and maintaining relational databases, developing advanced SQL queries, and building Extract, Transform, and Load (ETL) \& data integration pipelines.
* Programming \& analytics skills: Proficiency in Power BI, Python, R, or similar languages for data processing, cleaning, analysis, reporting, visualization, dashboards, and business intelligence initiatives.
* Healthcare research data experience: Strong experience working with healthcare, clinical, administrative, or research datasets, Fast Healthcare Interoperability Resources (FHIR), electronic medical records, and regulated environments involving privacy, data governance, and identified personal health information.
* Systems Integration \& Quality Assurance: Experience utilizing/developing APIs, web services, server\-side applications, system integrations, computerized system validation (CSV), and software quality assurance practices.
* Collaborative versatility: Experience collaborating with multidisciplinary teams consisting of researchers, clinicians, analysts, and information technology professionals is desirable.
* Cybersecurity and Data Stewardship: Awareness of cybersecurity best practices and experience to incorporating security, role\-based access, and data governance considerations into data and information systems.
* Experience with REDCap is highly valued.
* Additional consideration will be given to otherwise qualified candidates who have experience designing and maintaining web content using HTML, CSS, and JavaScript, as well as working with server\-side web technologies such as HTTP servers and PHP.
* Experience with full\-stack web development is an asset.
* An acceptable equivalent combination of education and experience may be considered.

**SKILLS AND ABILITIES:**


* Practical working knowledge of probability, statistics, and research design is required.
* Strong analytical, critical\-thinking, and problem\-solving skills are required.
* Strong oral and written communication skills, including the ability to translate complex technical concepts and requirements into clear, understandable information for technical and non\-technical stakeholders is required.
* Ability to build and maintain effective working relationships with clients, manage expectations, and respond constructively to concerns are required.
* Commitment to data quality, data integrity, reproducibility, and continuous process improvement is required.
* Leadership, independence, organization, and professional judgment: Ability to work independently with minimal supervision, establish and maintain appropriate practices and procedures, set team priorities, manage multiple demands and time constraints, and exercise sound judgment while ensuring alignment with organizational objectives and applicable policies. Ability to exercise significant independent judgment to train, mentor, coordinate, accept the work of, and delegate tasks to junior staff is required.
* Demonstrated attention to detail, accuracy, written communication, and good word processing skills, as evidenced by the submission of a complete, clear, accurate, concise, effectively formatted, and professionally prepared CV and cover letter that are tailored to the listed requirements of the position is required.
* A satisfactory work record, including satisfactory attendance and punctuality, is required.

  

**Key responsibilities**
------------------------


**Lead the design, development, testing, implementation, and maintenance of database application systems. Provide technical leadership to a sub\-team of data management analysts within the University of Manitoba Data Coordinating Centre, focusing on exercising independent judgment and autonomy when conducting and coordinating the following activities:**
* Lead the design, development, and maintenance of relational databases and REDCap projects supporting operational, administrative, quality improvement, and research activities.
* Develop and manage data integration and Extract, Transform, Load (ETL) processes, including automated ingestion, transformation, normalization, validation, and quality assurance of data from EMRs and other sources.
* Create data products and technical solutions, including server\-side applications, structured datasets, SQL queries, reports, dashboards, analytics, and workflow automation using tools such as Python, PHP, R, APIs, and SQL
* Ensure data governance, privacy, security, and quality compliance, including PHIA requirements, access controls, audit logging, validation processes, and documentation standards.
* Exercise significant independence and judgment in collaborating and consulting with researchers, clinicians, analysts, and stakeholders to translate business and research requirements into technical solutions.
* Provide initiative, training and support when contributing to strategic planning and platform development.
* Improve, write, and finalize Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) and develop associated workflow processes. Exercise independence in enforcing adherence to SOPs.

**Develop reporting standards and procedures for information captured within administrative datasets:**
* Develop flexible reporting systems that can be routinely run on database to uncover insights into how health care system is utilized.
* Performs and directs descriptive analysis, data quality monitoring, query issuing and resolution, data processing, and visualizations of imperfect datasets.

**Project management, delegation, mentorship, and training in research data management:**
* Schedule and co\-ordinate consultation/training events with relevant user and stakeholder groups. Exercises a high degree of judgment and independence of action when consulting with investigators and external project teams.
* Mentors junior team members, delegates tasks, accepts/rejects work, and coordinates the activities of other data management analysts. Applies a high level of independent judgment in training, evaluating, and providing guidance on the work of team members.
* Contributes to hiring committees when recruiting new team members.
* Provides regular reports of project status to the DCC Lead and stakeholders. Effectively communicates project status to the DCC Lead in order to collaboratively assess deliverables, identify opportunities for improvement, and ensure alignment with organizational standards and requirements.

**Other:**
* Stays up to date on current developments in clinical research data management software and applications.
* Ensure that CHI/ Aurora staff have up to date information about clinical research data management activities.
* Oversees the installation, validation, and maintenance of CHI’s clinical research data management infrastructure.
* Responds to regulatory audits and inspections by explaining and contextualizing data management documentation, data management plans, and project configurations.
* Assists with REDCap system administration. Enforces REDCap project management processes, User Agreement, system security precautions, and account management processes.
* Coordinates ethics/impact submissions for projects.
* May be required to perform related duties not exceeding skills and capabilities as required.

--------------------------

**About Apee Panchhi Team**

Apee Panchhi Team operates through RE/MAX Executives Realty in Winnipeg and provides real estate services across residential and commercial markets.

The team’s operations include residential and commercial property transactions, construction and development\-related activities, and the management of owned and investment properties, including retail properties.

As the team continues to expand its use of technology, automation, data, and artificial intelligence, we are seeking an Information Systems Analyst to support and improve the systems and processes used across these operations.

**About the Role**

Apee Panchhi Team is seeking a hands\-on **Information Systems Analyst** to analyze, develop, implement, and improve the information systems, workflows, data processes, and technology used across its real estate operations.

This is a **permanent, long\-term, full\-time position with a minimum of 30 hours of work per week.**

The successful candidate will work with team members and other stakeholders to understand operational requirements, improve existing processes, implement technology enabled solutions, automate repetitive work, and support accurate and timely business information.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Review and analyze existing business processes, information systems, and workflows to identify inefficiencies, data issues, operational gaps, and opportunities for improvement.
* Gather and document business requirements from team members, clients, and other stakeholders and translate those requirements into practical system, data, and workflow solutions.
* Design, configure, implement, and support business systems used for lead management, property searches, transaction tracking, task management, client information, and internal operations.
* Develop and maintain automated workflows, AI\-enabled tools, and system integrations to reduce manual work, improve information flow, and support activities such as property research, lead management, follow\-ups, and internal task assignment.
* Create and improve systems for tracking leads, property requirements, listings, transaction milestones, deadlines, possession dates, responsibilities, and other operational information.
* Develop reporting processes, dashboards, and automated reports to support management oversight, monitor workflow status, identify outstanding items, and improve business decision\-making.
* Use data, automation, APIs, and AI\-enabled solutions to collect, organize, evaluate, and manage information from real estate platforms, websites, CRM systems, and other relevant business sources.
* Work with buyers, sellers, agents, and other stakeholders to understand property requirements, maintain ongoing communication, and use internal systems, data, and AI\-enabled tools to help identify and evaluate suitable residential and commercial properties.
* Design and maintain automated workflows supporting approved marketing and social\-media activities, including content scheduling, task assignment, deadlines, approvals, and distribution across relevant platforms.
* Test, troubleshoot, and improve systems, integrations, automations, data synchronization, user access, and other technology\-related processes to ensure reliability and accuracy.
* Evaluate new software, AI tools, automation platforms, and emerging technologies and assist with their implementation where they can improve business operations.
* Maintain system documentation, procedures, data\-management practices, and internal technology standards, and provide training and support to staff using business systems and new technologies.
* Liaise with software vendors, technology providers, and internal stakeholders regarding system requirements, integrations, technical issues, upgrades, and ongoing improvements.

**Qualifications** 

* Bachelor’s degree or diploma in Computer Science, Information Technology, Information Systems, Business Technology, Business Administration, or a related field.
* 1\+ years of experience with information systems, business systems, CRM platforms, workflow automation, IT support, data analysis, reporting, or related technology.
* 1\+ years of experience in a customer\-facing, client\-facing, or stakeholder\-facing environment.
* Strong working knowledge of Microsoft Excel and common business productivity applications.
* Experience with databases, SQL, Power BI, APIs, scripting, automation platforms, CRM systems, or similar technologies is considered an asset.
* Experience with AI\-enabled applications, AI agents, workflow automation, or generative AI technologies is considered an asset.
* Experience with tools such as Airtable, Power Automate, Zapier, Make, or similar business workflow platforms is considered an asset.
* Experience in real estate, property management, construction, or another client focused professional environment is considered an asset.

**Skills \& Attributes** 

* Strong analytical and problem\-solving ability.
* Ability to understand business requirements and translate them into practical technology and information\-system solutions.
* Excellent attention to detail and commitment to data accuracy.
* Strong organizational skills and ability to manage multiple priorities.
* High level of accountability, reliability, adaptability, and initiative.
* Comfortable working independently and identifying opportunities for process and system improvement.
* Ability to communicate technical concepts clearly to non\-technical users.
* Excellent written, verbal, and interpersonal communication skills.
* Comfortable working in an environment with evolving requirements and a high degree of ambiguity.
* Strong commitment to providing effective internal and client service.

**Conditions of Employment**

* This is a permanent, long\-term, full\-time position with a minimum of 30 hours of work per week.
* Must be legally eligible to work in Canada.
* A background check satisfactory to the employer may be required before employment begins.

description:
**Role: Employee Benefit Analyst**

Build a meaningful career in one of Canada’s most resilient and evolving industries.

At JRP, we help organizations make confident, well\-informed decisions about employee benefits, retirement, and HR solutions. We are looking for a detail\-oriented and highly organized individual to join our team and help turn data and insights into clear, client\-ready deliverables. We are looking for someone who believes in dedication to their work, and in their own personal development within our organization.

**Why Join JRP?**

* Work with a high\-performing team that values accuracy, collaboration, and continuous improvement.
* Contribute to work that directly supports Canadian employers and their employees.
* Grow your career in a supportive environment that encourages learning and professional development.
* Flexible health and wellness/lifestyle spending accounts.
* Unlimited Employee and Family Assistance Plan and free Virtual Health Care services.
* Build long\-term financial security through a Registered Retirement Savings Plan with contribution matching.
* Through dedication, efficiency, and a commitment to excellence, our team enjoys the benefit of a four\-day work week.

**About the Opportunity**

In this role, you will support the development of analytical reports, proposals, reviews, and client\-facing materials. You will help ensure that the information we provide is accurate, consistent, insightful, and easy for clients to understand.

**What You’ll Do**

* Request, run, review, and organize insurer reports and data to ensure completeness and accuracy.
* Prepare analyses for group benefits renewals, plan design reviews and insurer proposals.
* Summarize data, findings, and recommendations in clear, polished, client\-ready formats.
* Support the creation and editing of proposals, reviews, reports, and presentations.
* Edit and proofread materials for accuracy, clarity, consistency, and alignment with JRP standards.
* Manage deadlines by establishing priorities and timelines for information gathering, writing, review, and approval steps.
* Assist with special projects as needed.

**What We’re Looking For**

* Exceptional attention to detail and strong commitment to performing with a high level of accuracy.
* Comfortable working with data, analysis, and detailed documents.
* Strong organization skills and the ability to manage multiple priorities.
* Proactive and resourceful when problem solving.
* Desire and eagerness to learn, takes direction well.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Outlook, Excel, Word, and PowerPoint.
* Self\-motivated, take pride in your work, and have a drive to succeed.

**Educational Requirements:**

Post\-secondary education with a focus in Business/Commerce preferred

Join JRP today and become part of an organization that is transforming the way Canadian’s experience benefits.

Working together with our clients, we develop creative solutions that enhance total rewards programs and support the people who rely on them. If you are motivated by meaningful work, thoughtful analysis, and a team\-first culture, we would love to hear from you.

**Apply**

**To be considered for this position, please include a cover letter with your resume.**

This is a full\-time, permanent opportunity. The successful candidate may have the opportunity to work remotely but***must be located in the Winnipeg, MB area.***

We thank all applicants for their interest. Only candidates selected for an interview will be contacted.

* Employee assistance program
* Extended health care
* Life insurance
* Paid time off
* RRSP match
* Vision care
* Wellness program
* Work from home

**Who We Are:**  

Price Industries Limited, North America’s leading manufacturer and distributor of air distribution products (www.priceindustries.com). The founding principles of Price have never changed – business integrity, first\-class service, innovation and a commitment to people. Our dependable quality, reliable delivery, and knowledgeable follow\-up service have made Price a market leader in supplying air distribution, critical controls, and noise control products.
  
After more than 60 years, Price remains a privately held family company with a deep heritage and commitment to innovation and service. Our long\-standing vision, values, and the Price way of doing business are the cornerstones of our success.
  
We are a dynamic, progressive and innovative organization looking for new talent in our growing Winnipeg manufacturing facility. If you thrive on new challenges, and working in a friendly, team\-driven environment, you should consider the following opportunity.
  
  

**What You Can Expect:**  

Health and Dental \- Employees and their families enjoy paid benefits covering an extensive list of medical and dental expenses and services.
  
  

Manulife Virtual Pharmacy \- Access pharmacy services anytime, anywhere through the Manulife app, with eligible prescriptions delivered directly to your home.
  
  

Manulife Mental Health and Counselling Services \- Access confidential mental health and wellness support through the Manulife app, with convenient options to book counselling, consultations, and guided programs all in one place.
  
  

Life and Disability \- You will be provided with life insurance in a multiple of your salary with an option to purchase additional coverage.
  
  

Pension Matching Program \- Invest in your future with each pay cheque through our Defined Contribution Pension Plan and we will match your contribution (up to 3% of your salary).
  
  

Wellness Reimbursement Program \- Employees are eligible for a fitness centre or club membership reimbursement of up to $300 per year, this includes Fitness related App’s.
  
  

Personal and Professional Development \- We are committed to helping you reach your potential through training and education.
  
  

Community Involvement \- Generously supporting health, charities, youth, and education opportunities is our passion, and you’re invited to be a part of that.
  
  

* Our convenient Price Café offers free Tea and Coffee.


Product Application Specialist \- Air Moving
  
  

Position Summary
  
The Product Application Specialist is responsible for supporting Price Industries’ sales and profit goals related to a specific product category or product. Provide technical support to internal and external customers in order to facilitate the specification and sale of the business unit products, including guidance on application, performance, troubleshooting, competitiveness, sales and pricing of product and services.
  
  

**The Successful Candidate's Responsibilities Will Include:****0\-3 Months:**  

* Familiarizing yourself with Price Industries products, market strategy, sales networks, and day to day engineering workflows.
* Spend time training in a hands\-on fashion in our Price Research Center North laboratory located at our Winnipeg Head Office.
* Begin education on HVAC engineering, air distribution systems, and cursory knowledge of other Mechanical, Electrical, and Plumbing systems.
* Support the rest of our Project Engineering Team with fulfilling customer engineering requests and technical product support.
* Develop understanding of company software allowing for the sale, specification, and performance generation of our products.


**3\-6 Months:**  

* Deepen knowledge with Price Industries Terminal products.
* Develop understanding of internal projects, product releases, marketing and sales goals controlled and executed by our Project Engineering Team.
* Grow to support external customers through providing Application Support, Analysis, Quotation/Bid Support, Submission and Fabrication, and Installation and Start Support.


**6 Months\+:**  

* Support and assist Product Managers, Sales Management, and Account Managers with technical input to achieve the sales goals and penetration strategies for the product category or product.
* Support sales force training and events occurring locally in Winnipeg
* Support new product development and releases with sales, performance, and research and development processes.


**This role could continue to grow to:**  

* Support on\-site Project Management in the industry by meeting with contractors, engineers, and sales representatives.
* Support industry education opportunities including engineering meetings, travel, virtual and in\-person webinars and presentations, and product shows.
* Participate in industry engineering societies, codes, and standards such as ASHRAE, AHRI, and EGM.


**The Ideal Candidate for This Position Will Have:**  

* A College Diploma or University Degree in Mechanical Engineering or equivalent
* Strong interpersonal, communication, and organization skills.
* A process driven mindset, self\-motivation and the ability to take initiative.
* Aptitude and desire for excellent customer service.
* Ability to work both independently and in a team environment to meet timeline\-dependent deliverables.
* The ability to collaborate with co\-workers and Managers to resolve issues and conflicts.


Should this excellent opportunity interest you, please submit your resume, including salary expectations.
  
We appreciate the interest shown by all applicants, however only those being considered for an interview will be contacted.
  
We welcome and encourage applications from people with disabilities. Accommodations are available on request for candidates taking part in all aspects of the selection process. We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity. All employment is decided on the basis of qualifications, merit and business need.
